sets.title: Prefix Meanings
sets.description: Choose the correct prefixed motion verb

items.prompt: Она _____ в комнату и закрыла дверь. (She entered the room and closed the door.)
items.promptEnglish: She entered the room and closed the door.
items.hint: в- = into. Entered the room = movement INTO.
items.explanation: В- means 'into': вошла = entered (went into the room). Perfective, completed action.

items.prompt: Он _____ из офиса в шесть часов. (He left the office at six.)
items.promptEnglish: He left the office at six.
items.hint: вы- = out of. Left the office = movement OUT.
items.explanation: Вы- means 'out of': вышел = exited (went out of the office).

items.prompt: Автобус _____ вовремя. (The bus arrived on time.)
items.hint: при- = arrival. The bus reached its destination.

items.prompt: Она _____ из города навсегда. (She left the city forever.)
items.explanation: У- means 'depart/leave': уехала = left (departed from the city).

items.prompt: Он _____ к окну и посмотрел на улицу. (He walked up to the window and looked outside.)
items.promptEnglish: He walked up to the window and looked outside.
items.explanation: Под- means 'approach': подошёл = walked up to (approached the window).

items.prompt: Мы _____ реку по мосту. (We crossed the river on the bridge.)
items.promptEnglish: We crossed the river on the bridge.
items.explanation: Пере- means 'across': перешли = crossed (walked across the river).

items.prompt: Можно я _____ к тебе после работы? (Can I drop by your place after work?)
items.promptEnglish: Can I drop by your place after work?
items.hint: за- = drop by, stop in briefly.
items.explanation: За- means 'drop by': зайду = will stop by/drop in briefly.

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ в здание. (He entered the building.)
minimalPairs.explanation: В- = into: вошёл (entered). Вы- = out of: вышел (exited).

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ из здания. (He exited the building.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He exited the building (went OUT OF).
minimalPairs.explanation: Вы- = out of: вышел (exited). В- = into: вошёл (entered).

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ домой в семь. (She arrived home at seven.)
minimalPairs.explanation: При- = arrive: пришла (came/arrived). У- = depart: ушла (left).

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ из дома в семь. (She left the house at seven.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She left the house at seven.
minimalPairs.explanation: У- = depart: ушла (left/departed). При- = arrive: пришла (came/arrived).

sets.title: Sort and Fill
sets.description: Sort by prefix meaning and fill in motion verbs
sets.descriptionRussian: Рассортируйте по значению приставки и заполните

categorySorting.instruction: Sort by prefix meaning: Into/Enter or Out/Exit?

blanks: Он _____ к дому и остановился. (He drove up to the house and stopped.)
Мы _____ мимо парка. (We walked past the park.)
Она _____ ко мне в гости вчера. (She dropped by to visit me yesterday.)
Дети _____ через дорогу по пешеходному переходу. (The children crossed the road at the crosswalk.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: под- = approach; про- = pass by; за- = drop by; пере- = cross
hints: Drove up to and stopped = approached by transport. Which prefix?
Walked past without stopping. Which prefix?
Visited briefly (dropped by). Which prefix? She came and left = imperfective.
Went from one side to the other. Which prefix?
explanations: За- = drop by: заходила (dropped by, imperfective for round-trip visit).

items.prompt: When a prefix is added to идти (unidirectional), the result is:
items.hint: Unidirectional base + prefix = perfective (single completed motion).
items.explanation: Unidirectional идти + prefix = perfective: войти, выйти, прийти, уйти. Single completed action.

items.prompt: When a prefix is added to ходить (multidirectional), the result is:
items.hint: Multidirectional base + prefix = imperfective (repeated or process).
items.explanation: Multidirectional ходить + prefix = imperfective: входить, выходить, приходить. Repeated or ongoing.

items.prompt: Каждое утро он _____ из дома в восемь часов. (Every morning he leaves the house at eight.)
items.promptEnglish: Every morning he leaves the house at eight.
items.hint: Habitual action (каждое утро) uses imperfective: multidirectional base + prefix.
items.explanation: Habitual (каждое утро) requires imperfective: выходит (from выходить = ходить + вы-).

sets.title: Fix and Build
sets.description: Fix prefix errors and build sentences with motion verbs
sets.descriptionRussian: Исправьте ошибки приставок и постройте предложения

errorCorrection.hint: При- = arrived. But she's leaving the room, not arriving. Which prefix means 'out of'?
errorCorrection.explanation: Leaving a room = вышла (вы- = out of), not пришла (при- = arrived).

errorCorrection.sentence: Он каждый день выходил на работу в восемь.
errorCorrection.hint: Каждый день + present context = habitual present, not past.
errorCorrection.explanation: Habitual present: выходит (not past выходил). Каждый день = still happening.

errorCorrection.hint: Crossing a road = movement ACROSS, not INTO.
errorCorrection.explanation: Crossing uses пере- (across): перешли дорогу. В- (вошли) means entering, not crossing.

errorCorrection.sentence: Она уехала в город. (intended: She arrived in the city.)
errorCorrection.hint: У- = departed/left. The intended meaning is 'arrived.' Which prefix?
errorCorrection.explanation: Arrived = при- (приехала). У- (уехала) means left/departed, the opposite.

patternRecognition.question: Which two are perfective and which two are imperfective?
patternRecognition.explanation: Unidirectional base (идти) + prefix = perfective (войти/вошёл). Multidirectional base (ходить) + prefix = imperfective (входить/входит).

translation.english: She entered the store and bought bread.
translation.answer: Она вошла в магазин и купила хлеб.
acceptableVariants: Она зашла в магазин и купила хлеб.
translation.hint: entered = вошла (в- = into, perfective single action), в магазин (into the store)

translation.english: He left the house and went to work.
translation.answer: Он вышел из дома и пошёл на работу.
acceptableVariants: Он ушёл из дома и пошёл на работу.
translation.hint: left the house = вышел из дома (вы- = out of). Went = пошёл (по- + идти = set off)
translation.grammarFocus: вы- prefix for movement out of

translation.english: The bus arrives at three o'clock every day.
translation.answer: Автобус приезжает в три часа каждый день.
acceptableVariants: Каждый день автобус приезжает в три часа.
translation.grammarFocus: при- prefix for arrival, imperfective for habitual

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All prefixed motion verbs in various contexts
sets.descriptionRussian: Все приставочные глаголы в разных контекстах

items.prompt: Можно к вам _____? (May I come in?)
items.explanation: Asking permission to enter: войти (в- = into).

items.prompt: Мы _____ мимо его дома, но не зашли. (We walked past his house but didn't drop in.)
items.promptEnglish: We walked past his house but didn't stop in.
items.explanation: Passing by without stopping: прошли (про- = past/through). Не зашли = didn't drop in (за-).

items.prompt: Она _____ от стола и подошла к окну. (She stepped away from the table and walked to the window.)
items.promptEnglish: She stepped away from the table and walked to the window.
items.explanation: Moving away from something: отошла (от- = away from). Then подошла (под- = approach) to the window.

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ к нам в гости. (He dropped by for a visit.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He dropped by for a visit.
minimalPairs.explanation: За- = drop by briefly: зашёл (stopped in for a visit).

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ мимо нас и не заметил. (He walked past us and didn't notice.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He walked past us without noticing.
minimalPairs.explanation: Про- = pass by: прошёл мимо (walked past without stopping).

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ от двери. (She stepped away from the door.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She stepped away from the door.
minimalPairs.explanation: От- = away: отошла (moved away from the door).

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ к двери. (She walked up to the door.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She walked up to the door.
minimalPairs.explanation: Под- = approach: подошла (walked up to the door).
